notes: Android downloads now use a versioned file name, so you always get the newest APK — no more stale cached download.
The app fits every phone screen — the top is no longer cut off by the notch or status bar.
Back button in the top bar and Android back key navigations built-in.
The floating pen is removed when you close the app.
Manual 'Check for app update' in Settings shows your installed version and the available one.
Only one floating pen, and the quick-capture window follows the pen wherever you drag it.
Cleaner, roomier interface with Font Awesome icons instead of emojis.
